title: session-load's replays make no forge call: the red-pipeline hook reads a planted pipeline answer, not gitlab.com
goal: A session-load replay starts no glab or gh process and makes no network request: the red-pipeline hook (and any hook that reads the forge) gets a planted answer in the replay clone, so its sync_ms and starts do not move with the network or the operator's sign-in

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, 'bin'); os.mkdir(B)
mark = os.path.join(T, 'forge-called')
for name, body in (('claude', 'exit 1'), ('glab', 'echo "$@" >> "' + mark + '"; exit 1'), ('gh', 'echo "$@" >> "' + mark + '"; exit 1')):
    open(os.path.join(B, name), 'w').write('#!/bin/sh\n' + body + '\n')
    os.chmod(os.path.join(B, name), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'run', 'session-load', '--arms', 'A', '--reps', '1', '--out', os.path.join(T, 'out.csv')],
                   capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=1800)
called = open(mark).read() if os.path.exists(mark) else ''
shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
assert p.returncode == 0, ('run session-load exit', p.returncode, p.stderr[-400:])
assert not called, ('a replay called the forge CLI', called[:300])

gates.question: How does a session-load replay keep the red-pipeline hook from reading a forge?
options: set forge to empty in the replay clone's backlog.json (committed), so the hook answers not checked
plant a canned pipeline answer through a glab shim on PATH
gates.recommendation: set forge to empty in the replay clone's backlog.json (committed), so the hook answers not checked
gates.reason: a shim is still a glab process, and a canned answer needs a hook in bl_forge outside the touches
gates.answer: plant a canned pipeline answer through a glab shim on PATH
